import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    if n == 0:
        print("-1 -1")
        return
    arr = list(map(int, data[1:n+1]))
    if not arr:
        print("-1 -1")
        return
    min_val = min(arr)
    max_val = max(arr)
    print(f"{min_val} {max_val}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
